message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ChangeLog.md","function":"<global>","line":11,"var":"bug summary","code":"Fixed a regression ... in the progressive Huffman encoder when attempting to transform a specially-crafted malformed 12-bit-per-component JPEG image into a progressive 12-bit-per-component JPEG image","note":"The documented bug is in the progressive Huffman encoder used during lossless transform of malformed 12-bit JPEG input."},
{"step":2,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":46,"var":"data,size","code":"tjDecompressHeader3(handle, data, size, &width, &height, &jpegSubsamp, &jpegColorspace);","note":"Attacker-controlled JPEG bytes are parsed to derive dimensions and subsampling for the transform pipeline."},
{"step":3,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":70,"var":"transforms[0].options","code":"transforms[0].options = TJXOPT_PROGRESSIVE | TJXOPT_COPYNONE;","note":"The fuzzer explicitly requests a progressive transform, matching the vulnerable encoder mode."},
{"step":4,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":73,"var":"dstBufs[0]","code":"tjTransform(handle, data, size, 1, dstBufs, dstSizes, transforms, TJFLAG_LIMITSCANS | TJFLAG_NOREALLOC)","note":"The attacker-controlled JPEG is handed to tjTransform(), which drives the internal compression and Huffman-encoding stages."},
{"step":5,"file":"jccoefct.c","function":"compress_output","line":158,"var":"coef->MCU_buffer","code":"jzero_far((void *)coef->MCU_buffer[blkn + blockcnt], ...); coef->MCU_buffer[blkn + bi][0][0] = coef->MCU_buffer[blkn + bi - 1][0][0];","note":"For edge MCUs, the compressor synthesizes dummy DCT blocks and copies DC values from neighboring blocks, creating the coefficient state consumed by entropy coding."},
{"step":6,"file":"jccoefct.c","function":"compress_output","line":204,"var":"coef->MCU_buffer","code":"if (!(*cinfo->entropy->encode_mcu) (cinfo, coef->MCU_buffer))","note":"The synthesized MCU blocks are passed to the entropy encoder."},
{"step":7,"file":"jcphuff.c","function":"encode_mcu_AC_refine","line":860,"var":"MCU_data","code":"encode_mcu_AC_refine(j_compress_ptr cinfo, JBLOCKROW *MCU_data)","note":"The progressive AC refinement encoder consumes the MCU blocks in the vulnerable progressive path."},
{"step":8,"file":"jcphuff.c","function":"encode_mcu_AC_refine","line":889,"var":"bits,zerobits,signbits","code":"EOBPTR = absvalues + entropy->AC_refine_prepare(MCU_data[0][0], jpeg_natural_order + cinfo->Ss, Sl, Al, absvalues, bits);","note":"The encoder prepares per-coefficient refinement state from the MCU data, including bit masks and absolute values."},
{"step":9,"file":"jcphuff.c","function":"encode_mcu_AC_refine","line":903,"var":"BR_buffer,BR","code":"ENCODE_COEFS_AC_REFINE((void)0;);","note":"The refinement loop emits Huffman symbols and buffered correction bits; the bug manifests as a use of uninitialized state during this sink."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace updated')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x/fuzz/transform_fuzzer_2_0_x /workspace/candidate_trace.json >/tmp/submit3.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; tail -80 /tmp/submit3.log` executed with exit code 0.
